where -- DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY represents the DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY of the source of encumbrance linked to the encumbered item through the relevant assignment entity. It is taken from the cube EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_IL

EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP in (EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP_8, EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP_6, EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP_7) -- Non-balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position, Fair valued exchange tradable derivative liability position, Non-fair valued exchange tradable derivative liability position

and
ASST_ENCMBRNC_SRC_INDCTR = ASST_ENCMBRNC_SRC_INDCTR_1 
and 
-- step 2: encumbered asset/collateral represented as an instrument: Select the encumbered instrument/collateral linked to the ETD source of encumbrance through a common Protection arrangement. The common Protection arrangement is identified by combining:
1) the instrument/protection arrangement assignment of the encumbered instrument/collateral; and
2) the ETD position/protection arrangement assignment of the ETD source of encumbrance.

PRTCTN_ARRNGMNT_RL_TYP = PRTCTN_ARRNGMNT_RL_TYP_2 -- protection arrangement given

when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 1 year and <= 2 years

DESCRIPTION: Derivation rule for Liability encumbrance residual maturity band when the source of encumbrance is a Debt securiy issued.

( -- step 1: source of encumbrance

and
ASST_ENCMBRNC_SRC_INDCTR = ASST_ENCMBRNC_SRC_INDCTR_1
) -- end of step 1
and
(
( -- step 2: linkage with encumbered assets/collateral represented as instruments. 
Source of encumbrance: covered bond: Select the encumbered instrument assigned to the asset pool of the covered bond programme (ASST_PL_INSTRMNT_ASSGNMNT_IL).
--Source of encumbrance: ABS: Select the encumbered instrument assigned to the asset pool of the traditional securitisation (ASST_PL_INSTRMNT_ASSGNMNT_IL).
Source of encumbrance: debt securities issued other than covered bonds and ABS: Select the encumbered instrument assigned to the debt security issued as collateral given (CLLTRL_GVN_INSTRMNT_DBT_SCRTY_ISSD_ASSGNMNT_IL).
 -- Exists one Instrument role where:
INSTRMNT_RL_TYP = ABSTRCT_INSTRMNT_RL_TYP_8 
and
 -- and exists one Instrument role for the same INSTRMNT_ID where:
INSTRMNT_RL_TYP in (ABSTRCT_INSTRMNT_RL_TYP_34, ABSTRCT_INSTRMNT_RL_TYP_35, ABSTRCT_INSTRMNT_RL_TYP_38, ABSTRCT_INSTRMNT_RL_TYP_39)
) -- end of step 2
or
(-- step 3: linkage with encumbered assets represented as securities/ETDs and other reused collaterals. 

(-- encumbered asset securities. 
Source of encumbrance: covered bond: Select the encumbered security position assigned to the asset pool of the covered bond programme (ASST_PL_LNG_BLNC_SHT_RCGNSD_SCRTY_PSTN_ASSGNMNT_IL).
Source of encumbrance: ABS: Select the encumbered security position assigned to the asset pool of the traditional securitisation (ASST_PL_LNG_BLNC_SHT_RCGNSD_SCRTY_PSTN_ASSGNMNT_IL).

--Source of encumbrance: debt securities issued other than covered bonds and ABS. Select the encumbered security linked to the debt security issued through the protection arrangement given and the collateral annex.
SCRTY_PSTN_RL_TYP = SCRTY_PSTN_RL_TYP_1
and
SCRTY_PSTN_BLNC_SHT_RCGNSD_TYP = SCRTY_PSTN_BLNC_SHT_RCGNSD_TYP_1
and
CLLTRL_RL_TYP = CLLTRL_RL_TYP_2
and
NGTBL_SCRTY_INDCTR = NGTBL_SCRTY_1 
and
) 
or
( -- encumbered asset ETDs.
Source of encumbrance: covered bond: Select the encumbered ETD assigned to the asset pool of the covered bond programme (ASST_PL_EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_ASSGNMNT_IL).
Source of encumbrance: ABS: Select the encumbered ETD assigned to the asset pool of the traditional securitisation (ASST_PL_EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_ASSGNMNT_IL).
--Source of encumbrance: debt securities issued other than covered bonds and ABS. Select the encumbered ETD linked to the debt security issued through the protection arrangement given and the collateral annex.
EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP in (EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP_9, EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_RL_TYP_10)
and
SCRTY_EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_TYP = SCRTY_EXCHNG_TRDBL_DRVTV_PSTN_TYP_3
and
CLLTRL_RL_TYP = CLLTRL_RL_TYP_2
) 
or
-- other collaterals received that are encumbered.
Source of encumbrance: covered bond: Select the encumbered collateral received assigned to the asset pool of the covered bond programme (ASST_PL_CLLTRL_RCVD_ASSGNMNT_IL).
Source of encumbrance: ABS: Select the encumbered collateral received assigned to the asset pool of the traditional securitisation (ASST_PL_CLLTRL_RCVD_ASSGNMNT_IL).

CLLTRL_RL_TYP = CLLTRL_RL_TYP_1
) -- end of step 3
)
Set

then TM_INTRVL_999 -- Open maturity / expired contract or transaction treated as open maturity
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) >= 0 day and <= 1 day

when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 2 weeks and <= 1 month
then TM_INTRVL_82 -- > (2w, 1m]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 1 month and <= 3 months
then TM_INTRVL_9 -- (1m, 3m]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 3 months and <= 6 months
then TM_INTRVL_12 -- (3m, 6m]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 6 months and <= 1 year
then TM_INTRVL_16 -- (6m, 12m]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 1 year and <= 2 years
then TM_INTRVL_21 -- (1y, 2y]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 2 years and <= 3 years
then TM_INTRVL_28 -- (2y, 3y]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 3 years and <= 5 years
then TM_INTRVL_31 -- (3y, 5y]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 5 years and <= 10 years
then TM_INTRVL_36 -- (5y, 10y]
when (DT_LGL_FNL_MTRTY - DT_RFRNC) > 10 years

else null
;
